extensionDescription.message: Read complete ChatGPT conversations with local highlights, comments and read marks, and export PDF or offline HTML.

exportDescription.message: Read complete conversations, save highlights, comments and read marks locally, and export HTML, PDF or Markdown.

sessionHint.message: Private conversations use your ChatGPT login session in this browser. Only the selected branch is read, including all its user and assistant messages from beginning to end.

loadTimeout.message: Page loading timed out. Check your login session and try again.

progressLayout.message: Formatting and creating the question index…

readFullFailed.message: Could not read the full conversation.

readVerified.message: Full message chain and rendered counts verified: $count$ messages, $questions$ questions. $next$

assetProblems.message: $count$ attachments could not be fully displayed; see the notes in the document.

readyOutput.message: Ready to save as HTML, PDF or Markdown.

htmlSaved.message: Offline HTML created with a question index, styles and math fonts. Check Chrome downloads.

invalidUrl.message: Enter an HTTPS conversation link on chatgpt.com.

readerLibraryEmpty.message: Read a conversation to save it here. Saved conversations can be opened offline.

readerDeleteConfirm.message: Delete this highlight and its comment?

readerBackupTooLarge.message: Reader backups are limited to 100 MiB.

readerSelectionHint.message: Select text to add a highlight or comment.

Delete “$arg1$” from local storage?

Its saved conversation, highlights and comments, read status, drafts, reading position and folded questions will be removed. The original ChatGPT conversation and exported files will remain. You can restore it from a previous backup.
